summary: First-finish smoke test of Game Daily Tracker. Verified backend REST endpoints (games CRUD, toggle-task, uncheck-all, settings, daily-records, stats) and frontend core flow (add game with tasks, toggle task, uncheck-all, tab navigation to History and Settings). All backend endpoints returned 200 with expected payloads. Frontend UI renders correctly in Traditional Chinese with dark theme, add-game dialog works, tasks toggle correctly (stats update 0->1 -> back to 0 via uncheck-all), history tab shows stats cards and 7-day chart, settings tab shows reset-time input, notifications switch, save button and manual reset.
passed: POST /api/games creates game with auto-generated id and order
POST /api/games/uncheck-all resets all tasks to false (verified via subsequent GET)
GET /api/daily-records returns list of daily records
Frontend loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with correct zh-TW UI
Add Game dialog: name, url, and dynamic task inputs (task-input-0/1) with add-task-button
New game appears in sidebar with '2 個任務' subtitle and shows in Tasks view
Clicking a task toggles completion; stats card updates (Completed 1, Rate 50%)
Uncheck-all button resets completed to 0 (confirmed via screenshot)
Tab navigation to History (charts + stats) and Settings (reset-time-input, notifications-switch, save-settings-button, manual-reset-button) works
Toast '遊戲已新增' displayed after add
notes: Did not exhaustively test: edit-game dialog, delete-game via UI, bulk history deletion selection UI, mobile hamburger sidebar, notification permission flow, and auto-reset scheduler (setInterval time-check). These are deferred to full testing.
No auth in this app; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required.
Test data cleaned up via API after run.
